## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `02b5f1cb0b3f38f499e1e34a989da3c10cde6d6a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

Inputs read: card #33819 (body and all three comments: triage audit 6893644309, claim 6895851062, os-dev-report 6896378351), PR #33954 (body, 4-file list, net diff against `main` 895783a1), the check-runs on this head. Read outside the diff, never reviewed: `packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts`, `holdsSuperuserBypass` in `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`, `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, the ratchet script's header. `.changeset/33819-rollup-source-unreadable-skill.md` is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

**Security: the hits teach permission behaviour** (hiding a roll-up from a permission set, and when a field mask does not hide it). Judged as such in ① and ④.

Gate verdicts on this head (check-runs, read 2026-11-15; conclusions are the verdicts, none re-run here):
- success: Build Core, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, TypeScript Type Check, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Plan Test Core shards, Test Core (3/8), Auto Label, filter.
- STILL RUNNING at the time of this record: Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8). The skills gates this diff moves (token ratchet, skill docs / refs / examples) sit in the running Lint jobs, so this head is NOT gate-green yet; this record is the contract verdict only.
- none failed; the rest are skipped (opt-in or not selected).

### ① Derived judgments

Every taught-behaviour change in the diff, against the rule's code on `main`:

1. "`os build` warns for each permission set that reads the summary but not the child object, the aggregated field, or a field `filter` tests" — RIGHT. Those are the rule's three `security-rollup-source-unreadable` arms, in that order, judged only when the set reads the parent object and the summary column.
2. "The total covers every child row and answers only to the parent field's own access" — RIGHT. It is the rule's stated semantics (system-elevated recompute over the whole child collection, the column answering only to the parent field's own field-level security) and agrees with `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`.
3. "it should see the children → grant the read" — RIGHT. With the child object, the aggregated field and every filter field readable, no `unreadable` finding is raised.
4. "it should not → mask the summary on that set" with `fields: { 'project.task_count': { readable: false } }` — RIGHT. `fieldHidden` reads `fields["OBJECT.FIELD"]` with `readable === false`; a set that cannot read the column is skipped before any arm. Key spelling, `readable`, and the `definePermissionSet` shape (`name`, `objects` required; `fields` optional; `readable` default true) match `permission.zod.ts`, and the single-quoted `'OBJECT.FIELD'` key is the dialect `rules/security.md` already uses.
5. "after removing any View All / Modify All it holds on the parent (either overrides the mask)" — RIGHT, and it closes the one leak path the mask has on its own set. `fieldHidden` returns false when `holdsSuperuserBypass(set, parent, 'view')` holds, which is `viewAllRecords` OR `modifyAllRecords`, on the set's own entry for the parent or, absent one, its `'*'` entry. The rule then keeps warning with the remove-first hint, so "never finish with it standing" also catches the wildcard case the prose does not spell.
6. The worked example's two comments ("no `task` read: warned", "the mask: resolved") — RIGHT by trace: without the `fields` line `grantFor` finds no `task` grant, so arm 1 fires; with it the column is hidden and the pair is skipped.
7. The two cuts change no taught behaviour (see ③ b).

Leak paths checked. View All / Modify All on the parent: taught. A filter field: the mask hides the column whichever arm fired, and the grant arm is named for it. Co-held sets: only a co-held set that declares `readable: true` for the column, or holds View All / Modify All on the parent, restores it; each set is judged on its own, and the skill does not claim otherwise. The row-scoped sibling: see ③ c.

O1 (outside the diff, not a finding on it): one observation outside the diff is with the owner seat.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` holds: the diff publishes skill prose and one eval fixture, with no schema, runtime or CLI change. `Clause-②: no` holds: nothing is narrowed or removed for a consumer, and both declaration lines (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) are in the PR body and the changeset body. Check Changeset: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

(a) Authoring by an at-tier subagent inside a thread served below the mandated tier — ANSWERED, not blocking. The claim mandates the tier for `skills/**`; the PR body and the report both record the arrangement, and the tree was written on the claimed branch. Which model served the subagent cannot be read from this review's inputs, so that evidence stays with the seat. The text itself is judged on this head at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which is the check the tier rule exists to guarantee.

(b) Ratchet row 4127 → 4232 — ANSWERED, holds on the standing ruling's path. The script's header assigns the two checks to this record:
- Deletion of restatement in the same file is shown and is genuine. Measured on the two blobs: `main` 16444 B (4111 tokens), head 16925 B; the rewritten paragraph is 743 B → 504 B (−239), the new block is +720 B, net +481, `ceil(16925 / 4) = 4232`. The row is pinned AT the measurement, headroom 0, and the row comment's arithmetic is correct.
- Both cuts keep a home a reader reaches in the same section. The `procurement_receipt` / `received_amount` example: the section's code block shows `function: 'sum'` beside `filter: { status: 'received' }`, the paragraph still says any qualified "count or sum" carries its condition in `filter`, and the three-counts sentence still carries "one child feeds several totals". The predicate-recompute sentence: the section opens with the recompute on every child insert/update/delete, and "The recompute runs only on a child write" follows it. No rule lost its only statement; no eval on the head references the cut names.
- The ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 is quoted verbatim and untranslated in the PR body with record 6513306068, as the header requires.

(c) `security-rollup-source-row-scoped` left untaught — ANSWERED: leave (option A). The card's Done-when names only the warning; the sibling is an `info` note the rule itself calls often intended. Residual, stated plainly: the "grant the read" arm can land a set on that note when a row policy narrows its child reads, and the total still covers every row. If builds are later seen finishing with that note on sets meant to be narrowed, it is a new card.

(d) No pointer in `rules/security.md` — ANSWERED: none in this PR (option A). The Done-when asks for the skill's roll-up guidance; `SKILL.md` routes both rules files, the build output names the warning id the new paragraph is keyed on, and `security.md` already teaches the `'OBJECT.FIELD': { readable, editable }` entry. Note for the lane seat: eval case 20's own scenario arrives at permission-set time, so a one-line pointer paid by a cut in `security.md` is a reasonable follow-up, not a condition of this head.

(e) Example not marked `os:check` — ANSWERED: acceptable (option A). The marker type-checks the fragment's shape, not the lint behaviour the card asks to be checked, and the shape was confirmed here against `permission.zod.ts`. Unmarked, a later rename of `readable` or the `fields` key would not red this example; recorded as N2.

Other deviations in the report: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (declared, CI carries it); changeset title line before the declaration lines (Check Changeset: success); no reviewer request and the comment signature order are relay-process matters with no effect on the tree.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` — holds against the card's Done-when and the rule on `main`. It tells the builder to resolve the warning before finishing ("Never finish with ... standing"), gives the per-set decision both ways (grant the read; mask the parent summary with the `fields` entry the card names), never leaves it standing, and carries one worked example in the skill's own dialect. "Checked against the lint rule": the dev's proof run is the dev's account; independently, the trace in ① 6 shows the unmasked set is warned and the shipped example raises nothing. The View All / Modify All precondition goes beyond the card and is correct and necessary.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 20 — self-consistent on the mechanical cross-check: both `must_contain` strings (`function: 'count'`, `'project.task_count': { readable: false }`) are in `expected_output` verbatim; none of the three `must_not_contain` strings is (`project: { allowRead: true }` does not contain the `task` grant string). The prompt forbids the grant arm, so the mask is the one right answer, and the expected output matches the skill text.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — the row and its comment agree with the measured tree (③ b).

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — case 20 `must_not_contain` holds two strings a correct answer can contain while naming the form to avoid. `"safe to ignore"` is prose, and "this warning is not safe to ignore" is a natural correct sentence that fails the case; `"viewAllRecords: true"` fails an answer that restates the skill's own new warning in key dialect ("do not put `viewAllRecords: true` on `project`, it overrides the mask"). The lane's own precedent (the fourteen-case `must_not_contain` repair recorded in `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md`) is that an entry is the shape only a wrong answer writes. Drop `"safe to ignore"`; drop or narrow the View All entry. `"task: { allowRead: true }"` is the wrong answer's shape and can stay.

N1 (nit) — the eval forbids `viewAllRecords: true` but not `modifyAllRecords: true`, though the skill names both as defeating the mask.

N2 (nit) — the worked example is unmarked, so `check:skill-examples` does not guard its key spelling against a later schema rename (③ e).

N3 (nit) — `function: 'count'` as a `must_contain` literal is spelled in the data skill only as `function: 'sum'` with `'count'` in a comment; an existing case in `objects-fields-relationships.json` already asserts the same literal, so this follows the file's convention.

No must-fix. One should-fix (S1).

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `099fa848ce3664252db8fc40f49b612fba7f65a0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

DELTA record. It follows my record 6896463758 on head `02b5f1cb0b3f38f499e1e34a989da3c10cde6d6a` (PASS, one should-fix S1) and re-judges this head after one commit, `099fa848` "docs(skills): roll-up eval case forbids only the shape a wrong answer writes". Everything in that record not restated here stands unchanged on this head.

Inputs read: the commit diff `02b5f1cb..099fa848`, the net diff against `main`, PR #33954 (body, head), the check-runs on this head. Not the dev's account of the change: the tree.

**Security: the hits teach permission behaviour** (hiding a roll-up from a permission set, and when a field mask does not hide it). The taught text did not move in this delta.

What moved: one line in one file. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 20 `must_not_contain` went from three entries to one, `task: { allowRead: true }`. `relationships.md` (16925 B, 4232 tokens, at its ceiling), the ratchet row, the changeset, case 20's prompt, `expected_output` and `must_contain` are byte-identical to `02b5f1cb`. `main` has moved 895783a1 → 68e726d6 since the first record without touching `skills/objectstack-data/**`, the ratchet script, the lint rule or `permission.zod.ts`; the PR's merge base is still 895783a1.

Gate verdicts on this head (check-runs; conclusions are the verdicts, none re-run here): 45 runs, ALL COMPLETED, NONE STILL RUNNING, none failed.
- success: Build Core, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Test Core (1/8) (2/8) (3/8), Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Auto Label, filter.
- the rest are skipped (opt-in or not selected). The Lint jobs that were running on the previous head have all concluded success on this one.

### ① Derived judgments

No taught behaviour changed in this delta: `relationships.md` is untouched. The seven judgments of record 6896463758 stand as written. O1 stays withheld; a security item is with the owner seat.

The delta changes only what case 20 refuses:
1. `"safe to ignore"` dropped — RIGHT. It was prose that a correct "not safe to ignore" contains.
2. `"viewAllRecords: true"` dropped — RIGHT on the false-fail side: a correct answer restating the skill's View All caveat in key dialect contains it. Its cost is stated in ④.
3. `"task: { allowRead: true }"` kept — RIGHT. It occurs nowhere in `relationships.md` on this head (0 matches) and not in case 20's `expected_output`, which writes `project: { allowRead: true }` and names the forbidden grant only in prose.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. The changeset file did not move; Check Changeset: success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

(a) to (e) as answered in record 6896463758; none is reopened by this delta. (b) re-checked: the measured file and the row are unchanged, 4232 at 4232.

New in this round: the PR body on GitHub still describes `02b5f1cb` (it lists the three old `must_not_contain` entries and the gate run at `02b5f1c`). The tree is what is judged here; the body is the seat's to patch before the PR leaves draft, since the body is what the maintainer reads.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 20, on this head:
- Self-consistent: both `must_contain` strings are in `expected_output` verbatim; the one `must_not_contain` string is not.
- Does the remaining entry still catch the wrong answer the case targets? Yes, for the two wrong answers the card is about. Leaving the warning standing (no mask) fails `must_contain` `'project.task_count': { readable: false }`. Silencing the warning by granting the `task` read fails `must_not_contain` in the inline spelling the skill and the prompt's dialect use. It is a string check, so it catches that spelling only: a multi-line entry, added keys (`task: { allowRead: true, ...`) or a `'*'` grant pass it. That is the reach every `must_not_contain` in this file has, and an answer that grants and masks nothing still fails `must_contain`.
- Does dropping `viewAllRecords` leave the case unable to fail an answer that grants View All? Yes, by string assertion it now cannot: an answer that masks the summary and also puts View All or Modify All on `project` contains both `must_contain` strings and passes, although the mask does not bind. Only a grader reading `expected_output` ("with no View All / Modify All on `project`") catches it. I judge this acceptable and grade it a nit (N4): the prompt gives clients plain read and no reason to grant View All, the skill text itself carries the caveat, and every string that would forbid it false-fails a correct answer naming the caveat, which was S1.

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — unchanged; the judgments of record 6896463758 hold.

Findings:

S1: closed. Both strings a correct answer could contain are gone; the kept entry is the shape only a wrong answer writes.

N1: moot (the `viewAllRecords` entry it compared against is gone).

N2 (nit) — stands: the worked example is unmarked, so `check:skill-examples` does not guard its key spelling.

N3 (nit) — stands: `function: 'count'` follows the file's existing convention.

N4 (nit) — case 20 has no string assertion against an answer that masks and also grants View All / Modify All on `project`. If the lane wants one later, the wrong answer's full inline shape (the `project` entry carrying `viewAllRecords: true` beside `allowRead: true`) is narrower than the bare key and far less likely to appear in a correct sentence.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vldcg4`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- 为什么改:卡 #33819(p2),你的裁决「改为搭建侧处理」:不改规则,教 AI 在搭建时处理这条警告。

- 先看:relationships.md 汇总字段一节新增的那段和例子(View All / Modify All 要先去掉那句)。

- 席位意见:可以合。

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT, held for the maintainer** · head `099fa848ce3664252db8fc40f49b612fba7f65a0` · card #33819 · report 6896378351 · at-tier contract review 6896463758 (round 1) + delta 6896780326 (PASS on this head, `S1: closed`) · read 2026-11-15T15:22Z.

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #33819`. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, the `relationships.md` row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, one changeset (`@objectstack/skills` patch). **GOVERNED**, Tier H (`skills/**`). `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Premise measured:** no `skills/**` file named `security-rollup-source-unreadable` on `main`; the taught steps match the rule's three arms and its View All / Modify All handling, as the review judged against `packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts`.
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head: 45, all completed, none failing. Dev: 63 derived, 62 exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, prerequisite; CI carries it); skill docs / refs / examples and the token ratchet exit 0.
- **Changeset (read against the diff):** the grant-or-mask choice, the mask key spelling, and the remove-View-All-first condition each match the diff and the rule on `main`.
- **Accepted deviations:** authoring by a subagent pinned to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` inside a default-tier card thread (recorded in the body); ratchet ceiling 4127 → 4232 at the measurement after 239 B paid down, under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」; the row-scoped sibling stays untaught; no pointer in `rules/security.md`. Review nits N2–N4 accepted (example unmarked for the example check; `function: 'count'` follows the file; case 20 has no string assertion against an answer that masks and also grants View All, since every such string false-fails a correct answer).
- **Out of scope:** none filed.
- **Landing:** Tier H. The seat does not flip this PR ready or enqueue it. It needs the maintainer's merge, or an authorised APPROVED review after which the seat lands it.
